title: Kronos
summary: Kronos is the Legendary Titan of Time and the progenitor of the Krono-Titans. A hooded figure in the visage of the Grim Reaper, Kronos dons purple and gold armor and wields a large scythe, capable of wiping out those he strikes from ever having been born.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Kronos belonged to the Casterwill family, and remained hidden in the Astronomical Clock of Prague for many years before being stolen by Viktor Casterwill in the seventeenth century. It was eventually passed down to his descendant, Dr. Benway. [The Power of Kronos]

Dr. Benway and the Professor fought each other for ownership of the Ring of Kronos with the Professor coming out victorious. He used Araknos to put Benway in a wheelchair for good and become a loyal scientist and advisor to him. The Professor often attempted to summon Kronos but never succeeded. [The Power of Kronos]

After the defeat of the Professor, Dr. Benway reclaimed Kronos's Ring, and also helped himself to the most powerful Titans in the Organization's collection. [The Power of Kronos] When the Huntik team attempted to obtain the Ring, Benway set a trap and lured them to his base. Summoning Kronos, he attempted to use Kronos to wipe Lok and Sophie from existence, but missing, created a vortex that sucked in, sending them back in time to the seventeenth century. 

There, they found the Ring in the Astronomical Clock but were interrupted by Viktor Casterwill and Michel de Notre Dame. After defeating Viktor, Lok and Sophie found they had changed history by stopping the Ring falling into the hands of his lineag, thus preventing it from ever falling into the hands of Dr. Benway. After explaining the situation to Michel, he agreed to use Kronos and help them get home. The Casterwill Council then hid the Amulet of Kronos elsewhere. In the modern day, it was seen to be in a clock workshop as the ring on the shop employee's hand. [The Power of Kronos]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Kronos is an unimaginably powerful Titan who is able to manipulate the flow of time, speeding it up and slowing down at will. His sharp and perfectly aimed scythe is unable to be stopped by swords or shields and can wipe those he strikes from history, preventing them from ever having existed. {{source|The Power of Kronos}} His sheer power was so difficult to control, even a Seeker as powerful as [[the Professor]] was unable to invoke him. {{source|The Power of Kronos}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* In a deleted finished scene of the comic ''[[The Power of Kronos]]'', Kronos defeated both [[Lok]]'s [[Baselaird]] and [[Sophie]]'s [[Sabriel]] in one single hit. This was scrapped because it contradicted with later scenes where Lok summoned Powerbonded Baselaird later in the issue, as the story was set during [[Season 2]].
* Kronos is based on the Titan king and father of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twelve_Olympians Olympian gods] in Greek mythology, who was also named [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cronus Cronus]; his appearance is instead based on that of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grim_Reaper Grim Reaper].
